articles.title: Designation of Linfox Armaguard Pty Ltd under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026
articles.description: Media Release Number 2026-25: The RBA has today designated Linfox Armaguard Pty Ltd (Armaguard) (ACN 099 701 872) under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026 (the Act).
